reports.title: Upbound Group, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

lines: 2026 Outlook: Full-year consolidated revenue range narrowed to $4.68-$4.78 billion.
For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects consolidated revenue of $1.15-$1.25 billion, adjusted EBITDA6 of $125-$135 million, and non-GAAP diluted EPS6 of $1.00-$1.10.
